rationale: The stock has gapped up ~45% and is now completely frozen — five consecutive 5-minute candles all print at $10.44 with a 5-minute ATR of $0.01, meaning there is essentially zero intraday price discovery occurring and no momentum to capture in either direction. While the elevated relative volume and tight bid-ask spread are structurally interesting, the lack of any measurable price range makes it impossible to define a credible stop or profit target with a positive expectancy. With today already in a loss position and no mechanical edge visible, skipping preserves capital.
